query: WITH cohort AS (SELECT category_key, price_eur, currency, price_checked_at, purchase_link_status, affiliate_link, net_content_value, net_content_unit FROM public.products WHERE is_active = true AND lifecycle_status = 'active' AND is_chaarlie_recommended = true) SELECT now() AS captured_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(category_key) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE category_key END AS category, count(*) AS products, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_eur IS NULL) AS missing_price, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_eur IS NOT NULL AND price_eur <= 0) AS non_positive_price, count(*) FILTER (WHERE currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'EUR') AS non_eur_or_unknown_currency, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_checked_at IS NULL) AS without_price_check_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_checked_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND price_checked_at <= now()) AS checked_within_7_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_checked_at < now() - interval '7 days') AS older_than_7_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_checked_at < now() - interval '30 days') AS older_than_30_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_checked_at > now()) AS future_price_check_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_link_status = 'available') AS link_marked_available, count(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_link_status = 'unavailable') AS link_marked_unavailable, count(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_link_status IS NULL) AS link_status_unknown, count(*) FILTER (WHERE affiliate_link IS NULL OR btrim(affiliate_link) = '') AS missing_shop_link, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_content_value IS NULL OR net_content_value <= 0 OR net_content_unit IS NULL OR net_content_unit NOT IN ('ml', 'g')) AS missing_or_invalid_package_quantity FROM cohort GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((), (category_key)) ORDER BY GROUPING(category_key) DESC, category_key;
limits: One read-only aggregate query, with no customer data, live retailer fetch or price-audit run.
Seven and thirty days are descriptive reporting windows, not active or approved expiry rules.
A price-check timestamp is not proof of exact chosen-package matching; the current audit candidate has no explicit package-quantity fields.
Stored quantity checks establish only metadata presence/validity, not verified retailer size or formula identity.
Deployment lookup and database query are separate point-in-time observations.
Weekly cadence was verified in source; live server timer/monitor health was not checked.
